checks.title: Resolution authority
checks.explanation: One address controls resolution: HD85…PA9Q. The authority address is off-curve (program-derived address shape), which suggests program or multisig-vault control, but that is a heuristic only — nothing on-chain proves a multisig governs it. Resolution is only possible after expiry, in 4d 21h. The pm-AMM program has no oracle, no dispute window, and no timelock — verified in the program source (none of its 34 instructions implements oracle, dispute, or timelock logic) and disclosed in its own docs. The resolution authority's decision is final. This check cannot judge whether the authority resolved fairly in the past — that needs transaction history, which the desk does not read.
